paragraphs.source_en: The master had also warned him that if he continued in such anger, he would surely bring death upon himself, and had advised him to claim illness and ask to return to Kyoto. Perhaps there was reason in that. But was it truly right always to concede defeat before those in power? The founder Nichiren would surely have regarded such retreat and defeat as a lamentable act.
